goal: Tell a UOR Foundation repository whether it has every file its tier requires and recommends.

app.name: uor-repo-files
app.title: Required repository files by tier
app.purpose: Decide whether a UOR Foundation repository has the files GOVERNANCE.md 6.1 requires and recommends for its tier, naming a missing required file before a missing recommended one.

fields.name: tier
fields.means: the repository's tier: core framework, implementation, presentation or experiment

fields.name: contributing
fields.means: CONTRIBUTING.md, in the repository or inherited from UOR-Foundation/.github

fields.name: conduct
fields.means: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, in the repository or inherited from UOR-Foundation/.github

fields.name: security
fields.means: SECURITY.md, in the repository or inherited from UOR-Foundation/.github

meanings.missing-file: a file its tier requires is missing
meanings.advisory: every requirement is met, but a file its tier recommends is missing
meanings.conformant: every requirement and recommendation of its tier is met

rules.why: GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: README.md is required at every tier
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: LICENSE is required at every tier
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: CONTRIBUTING.md is required at Tiers 1 and 2
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is required at Tiers 1 and 2
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: SECURITY.md is required at Tiers 1 and 2
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: .github/CODEOWNERS is required at Tiers 1 and 2
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: a CI workflow is required at Tiers 1 and 2
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: CONTRIBUTING.md is recommended at Tier 3
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is recommended at Tier 3
GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: a CI workflow is recommended at Tier 3

app.otherwiseWhy: GOVERNANCE.md 6.1: every required and recommended file of the tier is present

properties.why: README.md is required at every tier
LICENSE is required at every tier and reported before a recommendation
Tier 4 has no recommended files in GOVERNANCE.md 6.1, only optional ones

examples.request: t1 present present present present present present present
t1 present present present present missing present present
t2 present present present present present missing present
t3 present present missing present missing missing present
t3 present present present present missing missing missing
t3 present present present present missing missing present
t4 present present missing missing missing missing missing
t4 missing present missing missing missing missing missing
t4 present missing present present present present present

stakeholders.name: Repository Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Keeps a repository healthy and needs to know whether it meets its tier and the first gap to close.

stakeholders.name: Organization Owner
stakeholders.text: Holds final governance authority and needs every repository measured against the same published norms.

components.name: GitHub repository settings
components.text: The files, branch protection and topic tags the request is read from.

components.name: Template gate
components.text: A template instance's just vv, which asks this app about its own repository.

threats.name: Missing security policy shown as conformant
threats.text: A Tier 1 or 2 repository without SECURITY.md is shown as meeting its norms, so vulnerability reports have nowhere to go.

control.name: Required files first
control.text: Every required file is checked before any other answer.

threats.name: Files misread
threats.text: The request misstates which files the repository has, including inherited UOR-Foundation/.github defaults.
threats.accepted: The app decides on the files it is given; reading the repository and its inherited community health files belongs to the component that sends the request.

quality.text: Each Req and Rec cell of GOVERNANCE.md 6.1 is one rule.
quality.measureText: Req or Rec cells of 6.1 with no rule.
